info.title: Dorisio API
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.0 specification generated from Dorisio SDK type definitions, client methods, and Zod schemas.

Dorisio provides payment infrastructure for creator monetization and Stellar ledger settlements.

tags.name: Creators
tags.description: Creator accounts, profiles, earnings, and verification

tags.description: Payment tips, transaction building, status checks, and confirmation

get.description: Returns a paginated list of public creators on the platform.
Retrieves public details of a creator by their unique creator ID.
Retrieves creator profile and engagement stats by public handle.

post.description: Sets the verified badge for a creator (admin/platform operation).

get.description: Retrieves total, pending, and confirmed balances for a creator.
Returns pending distribution amounts and next payout estimate.
Checks if creator balance has reached the minimum payout threshold.

post.description: Registers a new Stellar wallet address with the authenticated user account.

patch.description: Updates wallet friendly name or metadata.

delete.description: Unlinks a Stellar wallet from the user account.

get.description: Fetches on-chain and settled balance for a linked wallet.

post.description: Submits a cryptographic signature proving ownership of the wallet.
Issues a time-limited challenge nonce for the wallet keypair to sign.
Initiates a tip payment to a creator. Supports idempotency keys for safe retries.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional UUID idempotency key to prevent double charging on retries

400.description: Validation failed or duplicate non-idempotent request

get.description: Fetches paginated transaction history for the authenticated user or creator.
Calculates transaction success rates, volume, and count metrics.
Exports transaction history as a downloadable CSV or JSON document.

post.description: Constructs unsigned Stellar payment XDR transaction envelope for a tip.
Submits signed Stellar transaction to Horizon / Soroban RPC.

get.description: Checks whether a tip payment has settled and confirmed on the ledger.
Fetches details of an individual transaction.
Returns profile details for the authenticated user.
Returns combined profile, wallet, and balance summary for current user.
Fetches aggregated balance for a given user ID.
Returns all linked Stellar wallets for a user.

post.description: Authenticates with email and password, returning a JWT token.
Registers a new account and returns initial authenticated session.
Renews an active session token before expiration.

get.description: Validates current bearer token and returns authenticated user.
Returns time remaining before current token expires.

post.description: Webhook endpoint invoked by Dorisio on payment confirmation, payout events, and wallet links.
